description: Source code for the 'topologymanager' package, implementing container scope management, affinity calculation, and resource allocation for Kubernetes topology-aware resource scheduling.

classes.name: containerScope
classes.description: Implements the Scope interface for managing container topology hints and resource allocation within a pod.

methods.name: Admit
methods.description: Performs admission control for a pod, calculating topology affinity for each container and allocating resources accordingly.

methods.name: accumulateProvidersHints
methods.description: Collects topology hints from registered providers for a specific container.

methods.name: calculateAffinity
methods.description: Determines the best topology hint for a container based on policy merge results.
